substrate.byte_identical_result_artifact_reason: emitted_at is an ISO timestamp; see L04-C06

doctrine: A single LH-04 controlled mutation targets exactly one verifier authority; rejection at a different authority is a fault-experiment design error.

Authority classification methods are exactly two: structured_error_kind (verifier's typed errorKind alone is unambiguous) and message_prefix_inference (lab reads the verbatim error message). No composite / hybrid mode is supported; in particular, no classification joins errorKind with axis context, because the frozen LH-03 verifier does not expose a typed axis identifier.
Semantic repeatability, not byte-identity, is the durability contract: emitted_at timestamps make byte-identity impossible without destroying audit trail value.
The fault matrix is the closed-world catalog F01..F17; adding a fault is a schema-visible change.
